scope: Research only: moving-camera reconstruction for the current sharp-glass dragon

repositories.name: NRD
findings: Spatiotemporal denoiser guides, not an RGB-only drop-in
Linux scripts, Vulkan integration and embedded SPIR-V documented
Core denoisers target opaque surfaces; transparency needs application handling

repositories.name: RTXPT
findings: Pure specular pre-pass and path decomposition
NRD instances per layer; DLSS-RR blends guides and uses dominant depth/motion

repositories.name: NRD-Sample simplex
findings: Separate transparent pass traces reflection and refraction at the first glass hit
Reuses current denoised opaque radiance with confidence checks; SHARC/lighting fallback
Curved-glass motion uses a documented heuristic, then TAA/upscaling
Glass extinction has a nonconvex-geometry TODO; not a replacement for Cubey's qualified boundary tracking

other_primary_sources.name: SVGF
other_primary_sources.finding: Temporal reuse plus variance-guided spatial reconstruction from low-sample input

other_primary_sources.name: Primary surface replacement
other_primary_sources.finding: Secondary-surface guides; simple mirror transform restricted to static flat mirrors

other_primary_sources.name: OIDN RT filter
other_primary_sources.finding: Documentation explicitly says the RT filter is not temporally stable

other_primary_sources.name: DLSS-RR programming guide
other_primary_sources.finding: Requires color, albedo, normal/roughness, depth/motion and specular tracking inputs; Linux deployment not qualified in this pass

other_primary_sources.name: Spatiotemporal blue noise
other_primary_sources.finding: Sampling aid; not a standalone reconstruction solution; motion and high-dimensional-path limitations documented
